Statement: I clearly understand how my health data is collected and used by the digital healthcare platform.
The platform is transparent about who can access my health data and when it is shared.
The consent process allows me to clearly choose what type of health data I want to share.
I feel confident using the platform because I can easily withdraw or modify my consent at any time.
I believe the platform has strong measures in place to protect my health data from misuse.
I trust that the platform would take responsibility and address issues if my data were misused.
The platform communicates clearly and in a timely manner about matters related to my health data.
The platform's communication makes me feel informed and reassured about my data and services.
Because I trust the platform, I intend to continue using it for my healthcare needs.
My level of trust strongly influences my decision to keep using a digital healthcare platform.
